_about: Terrain hazard registry (task-745). Policy is data: the DC ladder is
author-tunable, not code. The compiler (task-747) attaches a hazard id to a
generated way or area; the engine reads this table for the check and its
consequences at the moment of crossing.
A `dc` ladder maps a strength threshold (1..20) to a DC: for an encounter of
strength S, the highest threshold <= S wins; a strength below the lowest
threshold uses the lowest rung. `ability` is one of the six abilities in
engine/abilities.ABILITIES. `on_fail` names condition tags the failure
applies (via the trigger/condition machinery) and an optional damage hint.

river.name: River crossing
river.message_success: You keep your footing and reach the far bank.
river.message_fail: The current drags you off your feet.

rapids.name: Rapids
rapids.message_success: You ride the chute and clamber out downstream.

cliff.name: Cliff descent
cliff.message_fail: A hold crumbles and you fall.

pit.name: Hidden pit
pit.message_success: You catch the edge and pull clear.

bridge_jump.name: Bridge jump
bridge_jump.message_success: You leap the gap and land running.
